title: Axolotl waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='15' ry='10' fill='#ffd6e5'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='22' ry='19' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
  <!-- gills left -->
  <g fill='#e86a9b'>
    <ellipse cx='26' cy='36' rx='7' ry='4' transform='rotate(-30 26 36)'/>
    <ellipse cx='24' cy='44' rx='7' ry='4' transform='rotate(-10 24 44)'/>
    <ellipse cx='26' cy='52' rx='6' ry='4' transform='rotate(10 26 52)'/>
  </g>
  <!-- gills right -->
  <g fill='#e86a9b'>
    <ellipse cx='74' cy='36' rx='7' ry='4' transform='rotate(30 74 36)'/>
    <ellipse cx='76' cy='44' rx='7' ry='4' transform='rotate(10 76 44)'/>
    <ellipse cx='74' cy='52' rx='6' ry='4' transform='rotate(-10 74 52)'/>
  </g>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='4' fill='#2b1b33'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='44' r='4' fill='#2b1b33'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='43' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='43' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 52 Q50 57 56 52' stroke='#b0476e' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ff8fb3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ff8fb3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- left arm down -->
  <path d='M28 68 Q20 76 22 82' stroke='#f7a8c4' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right arm waving up -->
  <path d='M72 62 Q82 54 84 44' stroke='#f7a8c4' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- waving hand -->
  <circle cx='85' cy='41' r='6' fill='#f7a8c4'/>
  <!-- little fingers -->
  <g stroke='#f7a8c4' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='82' y1='36' x2='80' y2='32'/>
    <line x1='86' y1='35' x2='86' y2='31'/>
    <line x1='89' y1='37' x2='92' y2='33'/>
  </g>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M50 86 Q42 94 34 92' stroke='#f7a8c4' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 86 Q58 94 66 92' stroke='#f7a8c4' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail fin edge -->
  <path d='M34 92 Q26 88 30 84' stroke='#e86a9b' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='66' r='2.5' fill='#e86a9b' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='64' r='2.5' fill='#e86a9b' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='2' fill='#e86a9b' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
